NoTomorrowVillage_Text_Boss_After.en: The sun is rising. Really rising.\nThank you.
NoTomorrowVillage_Text_Boss_After.fr: Le soleil se lève. Vraiment. Merci.

NoTomorrowVillage_Text_Boss_Intro.en: Today again. It was a good day, so\nit stayed. Break it, if you can!
NoTomorrowVillage_Text_Boss_Intro.fr: Aujourd'hui encore. C'était une\nbonne journée, alors elle est\lrestée. Brise-la si tu peux !

NoTomorrowVillage_Text_Boss_NoRoom.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
NoTomorrowVillage_Text_Boss_NoRoom.fr: Ton SAC est plein. Fais de la\nplace, puis reviens.

NoTomorrowVillage_Text_Npc0.en: Good morning! Good morning! It is\nalways morning here.
NoTomorrowVillage_Text_Npc0.fr: Bonjour ! Bonjour ! Il est toujours\nmatin ici.

NoTomorrowVillage_Text_Npc1.en: I bought bread yesterday. Today I\nbought it again. Same bread.
NoTomorrowVillage_Text_Npc1.fr: J'ai acheté du pain hier.\nAujourd'hui je l'ai racheté. Le\lmême pain.

NoTomorrowVillage_Text_Npc1_A.en: Fresh bread, today. A new loaf. How\nstrange!
NoTomorrowVillage_Text_Npc1_A.fr: Du pain frais, aujourd'hui. Une\nnouvelle miche. Comme c'est\létrange !

NoTomorrowVillage_Text_Npc2.en: Mama says tomorrow never comes. I\nthink it is hiding.
NoTomorrowVillage_Text_Npc2.fr: Maman dit que demain ne vient\njamais. Je crois qu'il se cache.

NoTomorrowVillage_Text_Npc2_A.en: Mama says tomorrow came. I told you\nit was hiding.
NoTomorrowVillage_Text_Npc2_A.fr: Maman dit que demain est venu. Je\nt'avais dit qu'il se cachait.

NoTomorrowVillage_Text_ReturnAsk.en: Ready to go back to the dock?

NoTomorrowVillage_Text_Stay.en: Take your time. The tide can wait.
NoTomorrowVillage_Text_Stay.fr: Prends ton temps. La marée peut\nattendre.
